text:
TCP::recvwnd
Description
This iRule command sets the TCP receive window size in bytes.
Syntax
TCP
::
recvwnd
<
size
>
Examples
# Get the receive window size of the TCP flow.
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
log
local0.
"TCP set receive window: [TCP::recvwnd 100000]"
log
local0.
"TCP get receive window: [TCP::recvwnd]"
}
